dedupe_keys.name: multienergysystem mes modelica library for dynamic district heating and gas hydrogen network simulation rse

description: MultiEnergySystem is an open-source Modelica library developed mainly by Marcelo Andre Muro Alvarado and Guido Sassaroli at Ricerca sul Sistema Energetico (RSE) in Milan for modelling, simulation and control of district heating and natural gas systems within multi-energy systems. It provides thermohydraulic component models such as pumps, boilers and heat exchangers for traditional and modern district heating networks, gas distribution network models for hydrogen blending studies, and real gas equations of state (Papay and Peng-Robinson). The 2025 Modelica Conference paper describes a fully equation-based fluid property formulation for control and optimisation use, gas quality indicators such as Wobbe index, higher heating value and specific gravity, and district heating models validated against a real test facility whose data are provided for reproducibility; a 2024 OSMSES paper documents that validation. The code is available free on GitHub under the MIT licence, cloned with submodules. Coverage is any modelled network. Caveats: an electrical package and experimental validation of hydrogen components are listed as planned, and a Modelica tool is needed to run it. Simulation uses are dynamic district heating and gas network behaviour, hydrogen blending and control design for coupled heat and gas systems. Related records: model-gasnetsim covers steady-state gas mixtures.
